newsitem.title: USA: Colo. Comanche 350 MW coal-fired unit down 2-3 wks.
newsitem.headline: Colo. Comanche 350 MW coal-fired unit down 2-3 wks.

text.p: The 350 megawatt (MW) unit 1 at the Comanche coal-fired power plant in Pueblo, Colo., will be out of service for two to three weeks, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Thursday.
The unit went off-line late Wednesday after a short circuit in a cable tray caused a fire, they said.
The Comanche plant's other 350 MW unit is said to be running at normal rates.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment on the outage.
The plant is owned and operated by Public Service Company of Colorado.
